title: Harden protected runtime secrets and systemd engine dashboard deployment
description:
Write production systemd units for Ubuntu (Dell PowerEdge R730 primary, development desktop secondary) for the trading engine and for the separate read-only dashboard. Harden mike_trade/controls/service_manager.py so the Makefile/CLI can manage these services safely.

Before editing, inspect:
- mike_trade/controls/service_manager.py (current service lifecycle helpers, if present)
- mike_trade/controls/ (other operator control modules and how live confirmation is enforced)
- mike_trade/config* and mike_trade/settings* (mode selection, state/data directory resolution, credential loading)
- mike_trade/dashboard/ (FastAPI entrypoint that serves the compiled React + TypeScript + Vite bundle)
- Makefile (service-related targets that delegate to the CLI)
- deploy/ (any existing deployment artifacts)

Implementation requirements:
1. deploy/systemd/mike-trade-engine.service: Type=simple or notify engine unit that runs the installed virtualenv interpreter/CLI entrypoint as a dedicated non-root service user. Load credentials only through EnvironmentFile pointing at a root-owned, mode-0600 per-mode env file outside the repository (separate files for SHADOW/PAPER/LIVE, for example /etc/mike-trade/paper.env). Never inline credentials. Set WorkingDirectory, StateDirectory/LogsDirectory (or documented equivalent absolute paths) with restrictive permissions (0750 directories, umask 0077). Restart=on-failure with bounded StartLimitIntervalSec/StartLimitBurst. Set TimeoutStopSec long enough for graceful drain, KillSignal=SIGTERM, and KillMode so the engine can block new entries, flush state, and unsubscribe before exit. Add hardening directives where compatible: NoNewPrivileges, ProtectSystem=strict with ReadWritePaths limited to the state/log dirs, ProtectHome, PrivateTmp, ProtectKernelTunables, ProtectControlGroups, RestrictSUIDSGID, LockPersonality. Do not use ExecStop or ExecStopPost commands that cancel orders, close positions, or flatten.
2. deploy/systemd/mike-trade-dashboard.service: separate unit that runs the FastAPI dashboard process serving the compiled frontend build (no Vite dev server). It must not have a Requires=/BindsTo= dependency on the engine unit, so it stays reachable when the engine dies. Use After=network-online.target only. Give it read-only access to the state database directory (ReadOnlyPaths) and no access to broker credential env files. Bind by default to localhost or an operator-configured address, use the same hardening directives, and set Restart=on-failure.
3. mike_trade/controls/service_manager.py: provide functions/classes that render or install the unit files, run systemctl start/stop/restart/status/enable/disable for the engine and dashboard units, and report status without leaking secrets. Validate that the env file exists, is owned by root or the service user, and is not group/world readable; fail closed with a clear error if not. Require an explicit live confirmation flag/token before starting, restarting, or enabling the engine in LIVE mode. Stop must request graceful shutdown (SIGTERM through systemctl stop) and must never call close/flatten/cancel-protective-stop paths. Add an instance-lock check helper (or reuse the existing lock module) so the manager refuses to start a second engine for the same mode database. Allow injection of a subprocess runner so it can be unit-tested without systemd and without credentials.
4. Never read, print, or log credential values. Mask any env keys in status output.

Decision budget: if a hardening directive conflicts with SQLite WAL writes or the Python runtime, relax only that directive and add a comment in the unit file explaining why.
acceptance_criteria: deploy/systemd/mike-trade-engine.service and deploy/systemd/mike-trade-dashboard.service both exist, each with [Unit], [Service], and [Install] sections, and both run as a non-root User=.
The engine unit loads credentials only through EnvironmentFile= pointing outside the repository. Neither unit file contains any literal API key, secret, or Alpaca endpoint credential.
The dashboard unit has no Requires=, BindsTo=, or PartOf= reference to mike-trade-engine.service, and it does not reference the broker credential EnvironmentFile.
Neither unit contains an ExecStop/ExecStopPost command that closes, flattens, liquidates, or cancels orders or protective stops.
The engine unit sets TimeoutStopSec, Restart=on-failure, and at least NoNewPrivileges=true, ProtectSystem=strict, and PrivateTmp=true, with ReadWritePaths limited to the state/log directories.
service_manager.py refuses to start the engine when the env file is group- or world-readable or missing, and returns or raises a clear fail-closed error.
service_manager.py refuses LIVE-mode start/restart/enable unless an explicit live confirmation is supplied.
service_manager.py uses an injectable command runner, so its behavior can be exercised without invoking real systemctl or reading real credentials. Its status output masks secret values.
forbidden_changes: change PLAN_SKELETON.json or any planning artifacts under .abracapocus/
commit or embed real credentials, tokens, or account identifiers
add stop hooks that liquidate positions or cancel broker-held protective stops
make the dashboard unit depend on the engine unit lifecycle
invoke real systemctl, live broker endpoints, or broad test suites as incidental verification
